author: Michał (Leniwiec)
name: Leniwiec film look presets
description: Two Polish-named presets by Michał (Leniwiec) from his film-look workflow, shared in the 'Editing moments with darktable' thread on pixls.us: 'Moja najlepsza krzywa' (my best curve), his refined base curve, which he recommends using with chroma preservation disabled and placed at the end of the pipeline like filmic; and 'Klisza filmowa CC' (film stock CC), a color calibration preset he runs as a second channel mixer instance for film-like color. He re-shared the same base curve unchanged in the 'What new features have we discovered or love in DT V4.4?' thread.
